basic_details.job_title: HLL Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for Accounts Assistant, Accounts Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: HLL Lifecare Limited (HLL), a Mini Ratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, has invited applications through a walk-in selection for Accounts Assistant and Accounts Officer positions on a Fixed Term Contract (FTC) basis for its operations in Kolkata. The walk-in selection is scheduled for 27.10.2026 at National English School, V.I.P. Road, Baguiati, Kolkata – 700059, with reporting time from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for applying for the above positions is 37 years as on 01.10.2026. content_sections.heading: About HLL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: HLL Lifecare Limited is a leading healthcare products and services provider operating under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India. Its Retail Business Division (RBD) engages dynamic and performance-driven professionals in the field of accounts for its Kolkata operations. Appointments are made on a Fixed Term Contract (FTC) basis.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: All original certificates along with self-attested copies to prove age, qualification, and mark sheets. Experience certificates and latest salary certificate with break-up. Aadhaar and PAN card. Recent passport-size photographs for verification. Community certificate in original issued by concerned Revenue Authorities for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates. Failure to produce the original certificates will result in disqualification from the selection test.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Only candidates with relevant qualification and experience will be permitted to attend the written test. The selection process comprises a Written Test consisting of Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs). The Written Test will be of 30 minutes duration and will carry a maximum of 50 marks. There will be no negative marking for wrong answers. The minimum qualifying mark in the Written Test shall be 25% of the total marks.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates should ensure that they fulfil all eligibility criteria before attending the walk-in selection. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The crucial date for determining the age limit is the same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience. HLL reserves the right to cancel, restrict, or modify the selection process, or not to fill any or all of the posts notified, at its discretion. Vacancies may also be increased or decreased based on organizational requirements. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Failure to produce original certificates during verification will result in disqualification from the selection test. The proposed place of posting indicated may vary as per business requirements, and management reserves the right to determine the final place of posting as deemed fit. For further clarification, candidates can contact 9188401559 or email [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What is the walk-in date for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in selection for Accounts Assistant and Accounts Officer positions will be held on 27.10.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The reporting time is from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM at National English School, V.I.P. Road, Baguiati, Kolkata – 700059.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts notified in HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notified posts are Accounts Assistant and Accounts Officer under the Retail Business Division (RBD) in Kolkata.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Accounts Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Com degree with a minimum of 2 years of post-qualification experience in Accounts and Finance functions in a reputed establishment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Accounts Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Com / MBA (Finance) / CA (Inter) / CMA (Inter) degree with a minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience in Accounts and Finance functions in a reputed establishment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 37 years as on 01.10.2026, with relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates as per Government of India directives.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test of 30 minutes consisting of Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) for a maximum of 50 marks, with a minimum qualifying mark of 25% and no negative marking.

faq.question: Q8. Is the appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment will be on a Fixed Term Contract (FTC) basis.
